name: Meteoric-Arete
description: There is no surface, only an endless fall through banded clouds: amber belts, cream zones, and storms wide enough to swallow worlds. Lightning flickers between the layers like thoughts of a vast mind.
In the calm seasons the world feels almost kind, which veterans say is exactly when it takes the careless.
Core samples from the deep crust contain isotopes with no known decay chain. The samples are stored off-world now, and studied reluctantly.
Every syndicate scout files the same advice: harvest fast, land light, and never spend a full cycle planetside. The wise ones follow it exactly once.
